title: Collapse of U.N. summit intensifies calls for new approach to climate talks
summary_full: The failure of COP31 after a dispute about whether a fossil fuel phaseout could even be mentioned has prompted calls for a system that relies less heavily on consensus.
summary_public: The failure of COP31 after a dispute about whether a fossil fuel phaseout could even be mentioned has prompted calls for a system that relies less heavily on consensus.
